title: Product Designer - II
requiredSkills: Collaborate closely with UX designers, developers, and product managers to craft intuitive, pixel-perfect interfaces and visual design assets.
Turn complex data and abstract concepts into engaging stories through compelling visuals.
Design at various stages of fidelity, from sketches and wireframes to polished mockups.
Present designs clearly to clients and internal stakeholders, ensuring alignment and understanding.
Work with a team that values intelligence, ownership, and a commitment to delighting our users.
Bring a strong engineering affinity, collaborating closely with development teams to enable practical and feasible design decisions.
Demonstrate a strong product mindset by owning problems end-to-end and balancing user needs, business goals, and technical constraints across the product lifecycle.
Leverage AI tools to enhance design workflows, including ideation, wireframing, prototyping, and visual design acceleration.
Design modern, scalable user experiences, including AI-driven features, while translating complex technical capabilities into intuitive, user-friendly interfaces.
Be empathetic and user-centered in your design approach.
Quickly create wireframes and mockups for fast iteration and stakeholder feedback.
Be eager to learn, iterate, and improve, with the humility to receive and apply design critiques.
Pay close attention to detail and produce high-quality work.
Not be afraid to ask for help.
Crave user delight as much as we do, even in the smallest details.
Communicate clearly and effectively, both in writing and speaking.
Have a portfolio that showcases designs that are functional, easy to use, and solve real problems.
Stay updated on design trends and incorporate new insights into your work.
Have experience working closely with front-end engineers.
Have a basic understanding of HTML and CSS.
Have experience creating and managing design systems.
Are familiar with designing data-heavy user experiences.
Have experience or familiarity with GIS.
Have done projects out of pure curiosity and passion.
Enjoy doodling and creating illustrations.
Proficiency in Figma and strong visual design principles.
Experience with design systems and responsive design.
Strong documentation skills.
Strong knowledge of typography, color theory, and iconography.
Knowledge of design handover and heuristic evaluation.
An experimental mindset.
5+ years of experience designing B2B enterprise products.
Experience working on scalable design systems with a systematic approach to product design.
Experience in 3D, engineering, photogrammetry, or photo/video editing domains is preferred.
